Sickle Wind.name: Sickle Wind
Sickle Wind.description: The user swipes a hand and throws a thin, curved edge of compressed air across a room. It deals slashing damage to a single target and cuts rope, straps, cloth, boards and tires in its path; the edge shows only as a ripple in dust or rain, so only a target watching the user's hand can dodge it. Strain: moderate.
